prompts.center: Use case: stylized-concept. Output ONE 2172x724 3:1 horizontal 2D SIDE-SCROLLING GAME BACKGROUND. This is an entirely NEW LAYOUT inspired by the INPUT PHOTO COLLAGE, NOT a repaint of its photographic perspective. ABSOLUTE CAMERA RULE: flat orthographic SIDE ELEVATION like a theatrical cutaway seen straight from the side. X goes left-right, Y goes up-down. NO vanishing point. NO path, creek, railing, bridge or beam receding diagonally into the distance. NO three-quarter view, NO isometric, NO drone view, NO photography perspective. All long girders, waterline, walkway and railing rails run HORIZONTALLY ACROSS THE IMAGE parallel to the bottom edge. Vertical supports are VERTICAL. Objects keep equal scale across the whole width. Use layered flat silhouettes with depth through overlap/contrast only. The source collage supplies the campus identity: PALE BLUE-GREEN RIVETED STEEL with orange rust streaks, mossy CONCRETE bridge supports, grey slender double tubular RAILINGS, narrow reflective CREEK, ivy and yellow-green autumn TREES. Newly design a broad side-on underpass: a long side face of steel girder spans horizontally across upper third with occasional rectangular concrete piers behind the walking plane. Behind it are low-contrast flat tree masses; below, narrow horizontal creek band and reflections. Near-bank soft flowing grass/earth profile and a clear HORIZONTAL towpath at about 72% height can support a later left-right character. Grey tubular safety railing goes sideways along it, never into distance. Make this a hand-authored natural pixel-art game stage with soft small undulations, not rectangular tile blocks. Pixel clusters clear and consistent, no photoreal texture. Keep center 40-70% height airy for future traversal additions. Keep horizontal feature heights consistent at both edges for later left/right extensions. CLEAN ORIGINAL WORLD: no maze, added ladders, corruption, characters, symbols, diagram labels, HUD, text, border, furniture or fantasy buildings. Read as a platform-adventure scenery strip with creek and familiar rusty steel landmarks, not a scenic creek painting. No converging lines anywhere.
